text:
raj: Heads-up — proposing a late-night APAC maintenance window for a NIC driver + minor kernel hotfix. Prefer livepatch (kpatch) where possible, fall back to rolling reboots. Window: Tue 02:00-04:00 JST. Need owners + backfill plan.

anna: quick q — which pools/labels are touched?

raj: apac-gpu-1 (A100), apac-edge-2 (inference), apac-gpu-spot-ones. Primary risk is NIC driver 2.1.4 causing transient egress packet drops under saturation.

mike: @raj can we exclude spot pools? also FYI some tenants peak around 03:00 JST, worth checking.

mike: ran quick query — apac-east still ~20% baseline 03:00-04:00 for embeds/fine-tune workloads (not zero).

lia: propose stagged cadence: edge 02:00-02:30, gpu-pools 02:30-03:30, validation 03:30-04:00. Backfill with 2 reserved g4s for the window. Cost est ~ $120/hr for 2 nodes (preemptible is cheaper but higher risk).

raj: good call — avoid spot to reduce churn. can we pin reserved capacity from eu for that night to apac? @anna to Ops?

anna: I can shift some reserved capacity via console for the 2-hour window. Finance needs to approve cross-region temporary spend (~$400).

finance-bot: finance-request: temporary capacity transfer ticket FIN-482 created (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-482) :receipt: 

raj: Ops runbook (short): cordon + drain node, warm KV cache backfill, attempt kpatch for kernel where available, otherwise rolling reboot. Abort if packet drops >0.5% in canary. Snippet: 

```bash
# cordon + drain example
kubectl cordon gpu-node-123
kubectl drain gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# livepatch attempt (example)
ssh root@gpu-node-123 sudo kpatch load kernel-5.15.36-kpatch.patch
```

mike: pinged oncall — @oncall-bot please confirm oncall for Tue 02:00 JST and escalation window.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: scheduled maint request received. Oncall for Tue 02:00 JST: sara. Pager escalation policy active (15m).

lia: I'll draft the runbook with detailed rollback steps and perf checks (p50/p95 token latency, socket error rate, egress drops).

raj: canary owner? will run driver on 2 nodes in apac-edge-2 first, then wait 15m checks. If anything >0.5% drop abort and revert driver. @anna can you own canary?

anna: I can own canary. I'll prepare monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds.

mike: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: maintenance window 7890123456 created on infra calendar (events tagged apac-maint).

raj: ok — next steps: anna prepares canary & dashboards, lia writes runbook, finance to approve FIN-482, ops to shift reserved capacity, oncall aware. We'll reconvene Mon EOD for final signoff.
